components.name: SiteFooter
components.doc: A website footer in three layouts: link columns with a newsletter signup, a single quiet row, and a closing variant where the ryan-ui arch rises in, oversized and cropped by the bottom edge, fading into the page.

components.name: SiteFooterBlock
components.doc: Preview: the footer with a switch between its three layouts and a note of the last link pressed.

members.name: external
members.doc: Opens in a new tab and shows an outward arrow.

members.name: onSubscribe
members.doc: Called with a valid address. Throw or reject to show an error; resolve to show the subscribed state.

members.name: variant
members.doc: `columns` pairs a newsletter with link columns, `minimal` is one quiet row, `logo` ends in a large fading ryan-ui mark.

members.name: brand
members.type: { name: string; href?: string; mark?: ReactNode }

members.name: tagline
members.doc: One short line under the brand.

members.name: links
members.doc: Links for the minimal variant. Defaults to the first link of each column.

members.name: legal
members.doc: Small links beside the copyright, such as Privacy and Terms.

members.name: newsletter
members.doc: Newsletter signup. Pass null to hide it.

members.name: status
members.type: { label: string; tone?: "success" | "warning" | "danger"; href?: string } | null
members.doc: A system status link. Pass null to hide it.

members.name: onNavigate
members.doc: Called for every link that is pressed. Links without an href render as buttons and only call this.
